name: Lieke Vermeer
bio:
Lieke's journey into motorsport wasn't exactly conventional. While most of her colleagues grew up glued to F1 races, she stumbled into the world through an internship with a small Dutch racing team, handling their social media. The adrenaline and passion surrounding the sport quickly hooked her, and she knew she wanted to make a career out of it. She thrives under pressure, crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations with a calm yet assertive demeanor.

Now at EKS JC, Lieke is known for her data-driven approach to PR. She meticulously tracks media coverage, social media engagement, and fan sentiment to optimize her campaigns. She's not afraid to push boundaries and experiment with new platforms and formats, always searching for innovative ways to connect with fans. What sets Lieke apart is her ability to translate complex technical information into engaging and accessible content for a broader audience.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Lieke is of average height with a slender build and a bright, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with campaign ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of herbal tea throughout the day.
